section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participant demographics for a single study. It describes a community sample of 300 individuals (156 women, 144 men) recruited from Vienna, Austria, with mean ages of 31.66 for women and 33.31 for men. Mean BMI was 21.94 for women and 24.01 for men, and 14.3% of participants had a university education.
